metadata.title: High-Contrast Noir Portrait with Luminous Eyes

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key monochrome portrait where the eyes are isolated as the primary light source against a dark, textured face.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, extreme close-up of a human face in deep shadow, rendered in grainy monochrome. The eyes are artificially brightened to a pure white glow, creating a haunting focal point. Typography is stacked at the top center in a clean, geometric sans-serif font that contrasts with the organic textures of the skin.
coreVisualRelationships: The glowing eyes act as the primary anchor against the dark mid-tones of the face.
The hair and background merge into a solid black void, framing the facial features.
The top-aligned typography balances the weight of the chin at the bottom.
The sharp geometric lines of the font contrast with the soft, grainy photographic texture.
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space surrounding the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame with an extreme close-up of the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing white eyes, positioned on the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the glowing eyes, moves up to the title text, then down the bridge of the nose to the lips.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black at the top corners and bottom edges, creating a vignetted effect that pushes the face forward.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Mid-tone grays (facial features and skin texture)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from absolute black to absolute white.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' has equal length horizontal bars
The 'S' has a tight, modern curve
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in two different scales for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 1970s geometric aesthetic and circular 'O' forms.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and sharp peaks.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast monochrome close-up of a face in deep shadow. The skin should have a grainy, film-like texture. The eyes must be masked out and replaced with a flat, glowing pure white light that obscures the pupils.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, white, geometric sans-serif text at the top. The first line should be significantly larger than the second. Ensure the text is perfectly clean and sharp against the grainy background.

verificationChecks: Are the eyes the brightest element in the image?
Is the typography centered and top-aligned?
Is the facial crop tight, cutting off the top of the head?

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white eye luminance.
Ensure grain texture is consistent across the face.
Confirm centered vertical alignment of the face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Luminous Eye Masking + Geometric Sans-Serif Overlay
